title: European Union
sacredPoliticalOrderDefinition: Draft operational shorthand for the durable shared meanings, legitimacy claims, memory, obligation, and sacrifice logic associated with European Union.
selectionRationale: Included to test whether sacred political order and institutional embodiment can be restrained by corrigibility, pluralism, and bounded sacrifice.
theoryTest: Tests whether correction capacity can restrain sacralization and sacrificial escalation.

candidate evidence can connect sources, passages, claims, interpretations, and scores

exclusionCriteria: unit boundaries cannot be stated clearly
sources are unavailable or rights-restricted beyond draft scaffolding
